text:
Nora: Quick sync  want to run a compact community launch for a new repo called 'starter-labs'. Plan: 1) short launch blog, 2) 40m live build-along, 3) a tiny reproducible bench + perf badge. Main goals: community contributors + developer signups. Anyone free to take owners?

Owen: Love it. Recommend a 40m format with 20m hands-on, 10m bench demo, 10m Q&A. Make the repo runnable with one script `start-local.sh` and a `--cpu` fallback flag.

Kai: I'll add `examples/mini` and a minimal dataset, plus `start-local.sh`. Will make sure the quick path gets people to the demo in under 7 minutes. PR tonight.

Sam: Messaging idea for the lead paragraph: "Starter-labs: a short, reproducible toolkit to run inference locally and measure performance. Ship prototypes faster and compare setups with a perf badge." Keep it scannable.

Priya: Registration plan: HubSpot form `hs_starter_labs` with hidden utm `utm_campaign=starter_labs_launch`. Add a checkbox `enterprise_trial` so we route to sales as needed. We'll tag leads and trigger a Slack ping only for enterprise-interesting leads.

Owen: Benchmark narrative owner? We should surface p50/p95 numbers, batching effect, and a small cost-per-1k-tokens stat. Also include short how-to reproduce steps in `bench/README.md`.

Kai: I'll create `bench/run.sh` that outputs CSV + PNG for marketing. Will include `--batch` and `--quant` flags. Marketing can use the png for social.

Sam: Social hooks (short):
- "Starter-labs  reproducible inference tutorials + a perf badge. Live workshop next Wed. RSVP -> <https://events.redwood.com/starter-labs>"
- "Run our perf badge and compare settings in minutes. Try the repo on GitHub. -> <https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-labs>"

Priya: Routing snippet for infra/webhook (copy for eng):
```
{
  "form_id": "hs_starter_labs",
  "fields": {
    "email": "email",
    "name": "firstname",
    "company": "company",
    "enterprise_trial": "property_enterprise"
  },
  "routing": {
    "enterprise_trial": "AE_QUEUE",
    "else": "DEVREL_NURTURE"
  }
}
```

Owen: Nice. Can we also only post to #sales-inbound if `enterprise_trial=true && company_size > 100`? Reduces noise.

Priya: Yep, I'll add that filter in the HubSpot webhook rules.

Kai: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-labs/pull/12  includes `start-local.sh`, `examples/mini`, and `bench/run.sh`. Tagging @Sam and @Nora.

assets-bot: Reminder: marketing assets folder created at `marketing/assets/starter-labs`. Upload PNGs to that folder.

Sam: I'll draft the blog and include a short bench table up top (scan-friendly). Also a tiny contributor guide section: how to open a `good-first-issue`.

Nora: Owners checklist (quick):
- Quickstart + examples -> Kai
- Bench scripts + output png -> Kai + Owen
- Blog draft + release notes -> Sam
- Webinar runbook + slides -> Nora
- HubSpot form + routing -> Priya
- Social assets (gif + png) -> Sam + design

deploy-bot: Rehearsal slots: Tue 4pm & Wed 9am. Use `/reserve rehearsal @Nora @Kai` to claim.

Kai: I'll push a small sample bench result: p50=82ms, p95=210ms (batch=4, local-quant). PNG at `marketing/assets/starter-labs/bench-snapshot.png`.

Sam: Perfect. We'll publish the blog Mon, run the live build-along Wed, and follow-up with recording + contributor guide Fri. Priya, can Growth run a 3-email drip for registrants?

Priya: Yes: 1) thanks + recording, 2) how-to contribute + good-first-issues, 3) enterprise trial invite. I'll set up the workflow and share IDs here.

Nora: Quick ask: can someone line up one community partner to co-amplify? A short co-host segment would be great.

Owen: I'll ping two partners: @edge-deploy and @open-ml-hub. They usually help amplify small workshops.

Kai: PR merged to main. Bench PNG uploaded. Tagging Sam for blog assets.

Sam: Draft blog link: https://docs.google.com/draft/starter-labs-launch  adding bench table and contributor section now.

Priya: HubSpot workflow `hs_workflow_starterlabs_07` created and live. I'll post tracking IDs once events are live.

Nora: Great work! We'll reconvene after rehearsal for final signoff. Thanks everyone :rocket:
